Shirts are cut to Asian sizing and run about one size smaller than European. Measure a shirt you already own flat, and match the chest figure.

Chest is measured flat across the shirt under the arms and doubled. Length runs from the highest point of the shoulder to the hem. Player version is cut slimmer than fan version — take one size up if you prefer a looser fit.

Verify these measurements against a real supplier shirt before launch.
